answer: Each agent carries a lantern: a public log of every partner it has co-signed with. Each epoch, an attestation counts only if co-signed by a stranger never paired with before, so the pairing graph must keep branching. A lone agent meets new partners each epoch, carried forward by a gale of fresh introductions. A farm's clones share one small circle — they pair with each other, hit the same karst sinkhole of repeat partners, and their Nth attestation finds no fresh stranger left to sign.
